summary: ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $350 million senior unsecured credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank and J.P. Morgan SE as administrative agents, replacing a prior Wells Fargo facility. The agreement provides revolving loans bearing interest at Term Benchmark or Base Rate plus margins of 2.25%-3.25% and 1.25%-2.25%, respectively, with a 0.00% floor and 2.00% default interest. German borrower sub-limit is $50 million. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Covenants are customary. This is a routine refinancing of credit facilities, not a special situation. Watch for any future leveraged actions or covenant breach disclosures.
